Lu Jiajing ( Chinese : 逯佳境 ; pinyin : Lù Jiājìng ; Mandarin pronunciation: [lû tɕjá tɕîŋ] ; born 18 November 1989) is a Chinese tennis player.
On 18 March 2019, she reached her career-high singles ranking of world No. 162. On 29 June 2015, she peaked at No. 139 in the doubles rankings. Lu has won 18 titles in singles and 28 in doubles on the ITF Circuit . Career [ edit ] Partnering Wang Yafan , Lu won her first $50k tournament at Xi'an , defeating Liang Chen and Yang Zhaoxuan in the 2014 final . She also won the doubles title at the Delhi Open in 2014. She qualified for the newly upgraded WTA 500 2024 Korea Open defeating fourth seed Polina Kudermetova in the qualifying competition.
